# Gradding Homes

> > Gradding Homes provides student accommodation booking services across the UK, Australia, Canada, and USA with comprehensive guides for international students.

The platform specializes in connecting students with housing near major universities in cities like London, Edinburgh, Manchester, Liverpool, and Birmingham. It offers accommodation listings, city guides, university rankings, and practical advice for students studying abroad.
